dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Ah, to think that the rumors of his passing would turn out to be true...

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Traveler. I hear that you came here from Mondstadt... In that case, I suppose you can feel the difference between our two nations now, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: In Liyue, even bit players such as myself have received Rex Lapis' grace in some fashion or another.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: It was my honor to have been able to provide the Silk Flowers for his Rite of Parting.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: I am no Qixing, and I don't possess a Vision, so that was the only way I could've been of help there...

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: *sigh* Let's not speak of it. I still have a business to run, and I can't run it with this frown on my face all the time, now can I?
